prompt: Out of all of the feature-length theatrical films that John Carpenter directed before 2015, which has the longest running time?
answer: **Starman (1984)** has the longest running time: **115 minutes (1 hour 55 minutes)**. It was directed by John Carpenter and released theatrically before 2015.
